name: Zeus (Volibear) GOD OF WAR
creator: sirdy789
description:
When using the Zeus GOW3 form (/laugh), some animations may look strange due to the blade's position.

When Sylas copies the ultimate ability, it takes on the texture of the Blade of Olympus.

The mod uses sound files from other champions, specifically Spirit Guardian Udyr and Kled Base, so the sound effects from this mod might play when using those skins. If you've used any of my mods before, you've probably noticed this bug, LOL💀...

The mod uses the "Volibear.bin" file to make the critical attack animation ranged, which increases the chances of the mod breaking with each new patch. Yasuo and Mel's W abilities have not yet been tested on this skin; if you notice anything wrong that could be considered a 'Skin Hack', please contact me on Discord immediately.
